subject: MedX Health — deployment-mode briefing and next owners
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Noor <samira@medxhealth.com>
Cc: Keith Liao <keith.liao@medxhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: MedX Health — deployment-mode briefing and next owners

Hi Samira / Keith,

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Below is a short recap + recommended next steps so we have alignment on deployment needs and a pragmatic trial plan.

Call recap (high-level)
- Primary constraint: MedX will process PHI in scope for the model. Keith emphasized data residency + strict access controls.
- Product ask: integrate a clinical summarization model into triage workflow; expected ~100 rps peak during business hours, ~25 rps steady.
- Success criteria discussed: p95 latency under 250ms for summary endpoint, accurate extraction of problem list on our prompt set (>90% recall), zero PHI exfiltration (verified in evals).
- Procurement: procurement team will require SOC2 + evidence of KMS integration and an initial contract template.

Deployment-mode options we discussed
1) Hosted API (fastest) — good for early functional validation; not sufficient for PHI without additional controls.
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool in our hosted infra) — predictable throughput, better isolation, but still outbound data from Redwood-managed infra. May be acceptable with contractual controls and VPC egress rules.
3) Private VPC / on-prem — recommended for long-term PHI workloads; gives you control over network and key management.

Our recommendation (pragmatic path)
- Phase 0 (functional): short Hosted sandbox (no PHI) for product integration, prompt tuning, and accuracy checks — 1–2 weeks.
- Phase 1 (compliance-ready trial): Private VPC trial with sample PHI data in a controlled environment — 4 weeks.
This lets product iterate quickly while security runs the evidence and procurement prepares contracts.

Proposed trial success criteria (we'll formalize in the attached trial-plan)
- Accuracy: >90% recall on clinical extraction prompts on your labelled test set
- Latency: p95 <250ms at 100rps sustained for 1 hour during test window
- Security: audit logs show zero external data egress and KMS integration is verified by MedX security
- Ops: onboarding runbook and run-through for incident escalation complete

Immediate next steps
- Samira: confirm you can run a non-PHI sandbox test dataset this week (we can seed with synthetic clinical notes).
- Keith: confirm which compliance documents you need first (SOC2 report, KMS attestation, network diagrams).
- I will share the trial plan and security PSA (attached) and propose a kickoff for Sep 21.

Attachments: redwood-trial-plan-v1.pdf (trial plan draft), redwood-security-psa.pdf

Thanks — I put Ben Carter (cc) on pricing sizing and Lauren Bishop on orchestration questions.

— Olga

Samira — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers and proposed timing below.

Private VPC trial setup turnaround
- Standard provisioning for a Private VPC trial (Redwood-managed control plane + customer VPC peering) is typically 5–7 business days once we have the network CIDR, KMS ARNs, and an SRE kickoff window. If you need an on-prem appliance, estimate shifts to 4 weeks for install and validation.

Docs I attached (see files)
- redwood-security-psa.pdf — SOC2 summary, KMS notes, audit-log examples.
- redwood-trial-plan-v1.pdf — draft timeline, test cases, roles & responsibilities.

Trial plan (high level)
- Week 0 (prep): procurement & security review contracts + provide KMS details.
- Week 1 (sandbox): functional trials with synthetic data + prompt tuning (Hosted sandbox).
- Weeks 2–5 (private trial): Private VPC live with a narrow dataset of PHI for compliance and performance checks.

Success criteria (from the plan) — short checklist
- Labelled test set accuracy >=90%
- p95 latency <250ms at target concurrency
- End-to-end audit log validation and KMS key usage shown in our logs
- No changes required to your firewall posture beyond agreed peering rules

Next actions I will take
- Open a HubSpot deal (link below) and create a trial ticket for infra.
- Book a 30-minute kickoff for Tue Sep 21 (I propose 9am PT) — I'll invite the SRE and solutions engineer.

Ben — adding you for a quick sizing and any preliminary cost guidance for the private trail vs dedicated capacity.

Olga

Based on the call numbers (100rps peak, 25rps steady) we should size the Private VPC trial to support bursts up to 150rps for the first week of testing to be safe. Two immediate asks from our side to give you a preliminary cost/commitment estimate:
- Can you provide a ballpark of monthly token volume for summaries (approx tokens per request * daily requests)?
- Is MedX open to a 3-month reserved sizing for Dedicated once trial validates, or are you expecting to remain Private VPC long-term?

I'll put together a short pricing outline after those two items — nothing binding for the trial.
